name: review_surface_status
description: How an audit or a follow-up scan answered one review surface.
note: not_applicable and not_assessed reuse compliance-verdict's words. not_applicable is a judgment that the surface does not exist in the target; not_assessed is a gap, recorded also in metadata.additional.coverage_gaps; out_of_scope means a diff-scoped scan's diff does not touch the surface. None of the three is a clean result.
